messages:
Maya (Customer Success): Urgent — Obsidian Medical's invoice 6011 failed the scheduled card sweep this morning, Stripe returned `do_not_honor`. They're mid-deploy and asking for same-day options (wire, Fed/ACH or manual verification). Can Finance advise? :sweat_smile:

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=6011 customer=ObsidianMedical provider=Stripe code=do_not_honor id=pi_0Ab... log=\"card_decline_do_not_honor\"

Oliver (Finance): We can do one manual retry but recommend not repeating auths too quickly — wait ~10m. Given they're going live, wire is fastest for large amounts. If they prefer ACH and their bank blocks micro-deposits (common with savings/lockbox accounts), we accept manual ACH verification via one of: (a) bank letter on letterhead confirming account & routing, (b) bank-stamped screenshot/PDF with account holder name, or (c) outbound wire confirmation.

Priya (Ops): Ops note: don't run retries within 5m of the failed auth or gateways may throttle. If you ask me, I'll schedule a manual retry at +15m. Also, once Finance marks \"paid pending settlement\" I can release the provisioning hold immediately.

Hannah (Sales): Hold provisioning until we have payment or wire proof. If they wire today, we'll expedite and waive the expedite fee — tell them that to motivate the AP team.

Maya (Customer Success): Billing contact is ap@obsidianmed.com. AP tried Plaid and got an \"unsupported account type\" error (they're using a treasury/sweep account). They can do a same-day wire. Sending options now.

Oliver (Finance): Send the secure wire/Fedwire template only via encrypted email or our secure portal. Paste below for your encrypted note: 

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank (Fedwire): First National Bank of Redwood
Fedwire Routing: 026009593
ACH Routing (if needed): 061000104
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT/BIC: FNBUS33
Payment ref: INVOICE 6011 / Obsidian Medical
```

Oliver (Finance): Ask them to include payer legal name and invoice number in the wire reference and to forward the bank's outbound confirmation (PDF or SWIFT copy showing amount, timestamp, sender). When we receive that, Finance will mark invoice 6011 as \"paid pending settlement\" in QuickBooks and suppress dunning for this invoice. We'll also add a manual payment entry so AR doesn't auto-remind.

Priya (Ops): If they instead send a bank letter or bank-stamped PDF for ACH verification, Finance: do we accept letters older than 30 days?

Oliver (Finance): We accept bank letters dated within 60 days for one-off manual ACH verification, provided they include account holder name, routing and account number. If anything is ambiguous, request the SWIFT/outbound confirmation.

Maya (Customer Success): Sent secure wire template to ap@obsidianmed.com. They replied: \"Wiring now, will send confirmation to this thread.\" I'll paste the redacted outbound confirmation here when it arrives.

billing-bot: [payment.incoming] invoice=6011 method=wire status=pending tx_ref=OBW-2026-221

Maya (Customer Success): Uploaded redacted SWIFT confirmation (outgoing $16,200 USD, timestamp 2026-03-23 18:05 UTC, ref OBW-2026-221). Forwarded to this thread.

Oliver (Finance): Received. Marking invoice 6011 as paid pending settlement and creating a QuickBooks manual payment entry. Suppressing automated dunning and adding AR note: \"Pending settlement based on SWIFT confirmation OBW-2026-221.\" Release provisioning in 30m unless any flags arise.

Priya (Ops): Copy. I'll kick provisioning once QuickBooks entry shows.

Hannah (Sales): Thanks — will notify the customer that provisioning is queued and expedite the onboarding. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Customer Success): Closing loop, thanks team!
